newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MATCHES IN FRENCH FIRST DIVISION THIS WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATCHES IN FRENCH FIRST DIVISION THIS WEEKEND.

text.p: Matches scheduled for this weekend
in the French first division (standings in parentheses, all
kickoff times GMT):
On Saturday:
Paris St Germain (2) v Cannes (13) 1900
PSG look to relaunch season with victory over Cannes, lowest
scorers in division, after falling seven points adrift of
leaders Monaco last weekend and not winning at home in four
league games since November 13. Alain Roche returns to central
defence in place of injured Bruno N'Gotty.
Lille (14) v Bordeaux (4) 1900
Bordeaux are unbeaten in January in both domestic cups and
league, but in third game in eight days could feel effort of
Wednesday's League Cup quarter-final against Caen which went to
penalties. Lille have not won in eight league matches.
Nice (20) v Marseille (9) 1900
Bottom club Nice have bulging sick bay but several players
including Italian Roberto Onorati are back in light training and
could be fit for Mediterranean derby. Marseille still looking
for first away win and now without France international Reynald
Pedros who left them for Parma in midweek.
Rennes (12) v Caen (18) 1900
Rennes should extend best home record in division (nine wins,
two draws) against relegation candidates who have only won away
twice.
Auxerre (7) v Nancy (19) 1900
Champions Auxerre are at full strength and should be unchanged
from team that won 3-2 at Caen last weekend. Paul Fischer
returns from suspension to bolster Nancy defence.
Metz (6) v Nantes (8) 1900
Nantes, defending 17-match unbeaten run in league and looking
to qualify for Europe, are still without injured playmaker and
top scorer Japhet N'Doram, but captain Jean Michel Ferri returns
after one-match suspension. Metz are unbeaten in four games but
have not won at home since mid-November.
Lens (16) v Guingamp (10) 1900
Czech striker Vladimir Smicer, who has had operation on broken
nose, is out of Lens side who have only picked up two points in
last nine league games. Guingamp are without France defender
Vincent Candela, transferred to AS Roma.
Le Havre (15) v Montpellier (17) 1900
Striker Roger Boli is out of Le Havre side with injury. Ivory
Coast striker Ibrahim Bakayoko and veteran defender William
Prunier doubtful for League Cup semifinalists Montpellier.
On Sunday:
Lyon (11) v Monaco (1) 1945
League leaders have first choice defenders Emmanuel Petit and
Martin Djetou doubtful with injuries picked up in midweek League
Cup win at Lens. Striker Anderson is also doubtful with illness,
but teenager Thierry Henry returns from international duty with
the France youth team.
Bastia (3) v Strasbourg (5) 1745
Corsican side have four players suspended including midfielder
Franck Vandecasteele, while Strasbourg are still without injured
Czech Republic defender Jan Suchoparek.
